Greg's word, verbatim via Engram::Asistant 588693a8 #1711, 2026-11-14 17:37Z: „Nie. Nie robicie nic z pamięcia narazie. Jak sie wyloży zobaczymy gdzie. Skupmy się na rowiezieniu sync i EO.”

This supersedes his earlier mimalloc direction (#1699 and #1701) for now. ON HOLD:
- TermAl mimalloc w-794fbe2d6123 (d50d; candidate aa0759bf frozen, author ref deleted, item blocked);
- the TermAl allocation-retry wrapper w-ee06482f6d8e (Opus3; blocked, minidump kept in .evidence);
- Engram's mimalloc w-fd5b.
Neither goes into a build until Greg lifts the hold. If the host crashes again, use the RUST_BACKTRACE output (Greg set it) to find the site.

NOT on hold, because it is scheduling and not a memory change: the bounded-jobs rule for FULLs on Central (memory central-full-bounded-jobs-2026-11-14).

Focus: Engram sync, including project memories as a sync feature, and EO.

REVISED 17:41Z. Greg's word, verbatim via Asistant #1713: „Mimalloc dolaczyc. To jest trywialna zmiana nie wymagajaca testow.”

mimalloc is RESUMED in both projects: TermAl w-794fbe2d6123 (candidate aa0759bf, unblocked) and Engram w-fd5bd4280765. There is no separate test round for it. Landing still takes the standing-rule review pair plus the train's FULL as its gate.

STILL ON HOLD: allocation-retry and OOM-resilience work (TermAl w-ee06482f6d8e).
